import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, MultiPoint
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
from geopandas import GeoDataFrame
from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Create a GeoDataFrame from the station coordinates
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude), crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# Create Voronoi diagram
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(MultiPoint(stations_gdf.geometry))

# Clip Voronoi cells to the bounding box of the station coordinates
bbox = stations_gdf.total_bounds
clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(gpd.GeoSeries([Point(bbox[0], bbox[1]), Point(bbox[2], bbox[1]), Point(bbox[2], bbox[3]), Point(bbox[0], bbox[3])]).unary_union) for cell in voronoi]

# Calculate the area of each clipped Voronoi cell
areas = [cell.area for cell in clipped_voronoi]

# Add the areas to the GeoDataFrame
stations_gdf['voronoi_area_km2'] = areas

# Find the station with the smallest Voronoi cell
smallest_cell_station = stations_gdf.loc[stations_gdf.voronoi_area_km2.idxmin()]['name_en']
smallest_cell_km2 = round(stations_gdf.voronoi_area_km2.min(), 1)

# Store the results
smallest_cell_station, smallest_cell_km2

import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, MultiPoint, Polygon
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
from geopandas import GeoDataFrame
from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Create a GeoDataFrame from the station coordinates
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude), crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# Create Voronoi diagram
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(MultiPoint(stations_gdf.geometry))

# Extract the Voronoi cells from the GeometryCollection
voronoi_cells = [cell for cell in voronoi.geoms]

# Clip Voronoi cells to the bounding box of the station coordinates
bbox = stations_gdf.total_bounds
bbox_polygon = Polygon([(bbox[0], bbox[1]), (bbox[2], bbox[1]), (bbox[2], bbox[3]), (bbox[0], bbox[3])])
clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(bbox_polygon) for cell in voronoi_cells]

# Calculate the area of each clipped Voronoi cell
areas = [cell.area for cell in clipped_voronoi]

# Add the areas to the GeoDataFrame
stations_gdf['voronoi_area_km2'] = areas

# Find the station with the smallest Voronoi cell
smallest_cell_station = stations_gdf.loc[stations_gdf.voronoi_area_km2.idxmin()]['name_en']
smallest_cell_km2 = round(stations_gdf.voronoi_area_km2.min(), 1)

# Store the results
smallest_cell_station, smallest_cell_km2
